description:
Switch character, card, monster, Ancient, merchant, creature, event and combat background skins, with previews in the Other Compendium.

[h2]1.0.37[/h2]
Crash fixes for large visual packs, card rewards, missing Spine pages and the stable multiplayer lobby. In multiplayer combat a failing skin now falls back to the vanilla model instead of faulting, card portraits no longer stay blank, and merchants stay clickable after repeated hot switches.

[h1]NO RESTART! SWITCH AND USE INSTANTLY![/h1]

[h2]Details[/h2]
[list]
[*]Switch skins in character select and compendiums, or adjust appearance during a run.
[*]Organize your choices with priorities, presets, skin combinations and bundles.
[*]Browse the curated Workshop catalog and subscribe or unsubscribe in-game.
[*]Customizable themes and 15 interface languages.
[/list]

[h2]Important[/h2]
Offline compatibility checks passed for stable v0.107.1 and beta v0.113.1. Special-code skins may still need individual adaptation.
Skins are subscribed separately. Skin Changer adjusts its load order and prompts for a restart when needed.

[h2]Limitations[/h2]
[list]
[*]Skins with special code, gameplay changes or custom managers may need compatibility work.
[*]Newly subscribed skins may need a restart; check their Workshop labels.
[/list]

[h2]Open Source[/h2]
https://github.com/WhiteCatKing/STS2-SkinChanger

[h2]Version[/h2]
1.0.37

[h2]Submissions[/h2]
[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3787302680/592940620292752301/]Submit a mod on Steam[/url]
[*][url=https://github.com/WhiteCatKing/STS2-SkinChanger/blob/main/STS2-SkinChanger_%E4%BF%AE%E6%94%B9%E4%BB%B6/docs/publish-github-skin-mod.md]GitHub mod submission guide[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3787302680/592940620292746467/]Submit a theme preset[/url]
[/list]

This mod was developed with substantial assistance from GPT and DeepSeek. More feature requests and suggestions are welcome!
changeNote:
1.0.37.2 / 2026-11-20
闪退与稳定性：CZN 等完整视觉包挂载更省内存、同一个包再选直接复用；领取卡牌奖励不再崩溃；只带 imported 产物的 Spine 包缺页时回退原版模型；正式版联机大厅补丁适配改名后的参数；联机战斗中切换器自身的外观失败改为降级原版模型，不再把异常抛进战斗；卡面缓存改为 LRU 淘汰，只对真正失败的路径负缓存，浏览大量卡牌后不再整片回退原版。
兼容与界面：商人连续多次热切换后仍可点击；恐惧/极速模式选人界面按所选皮肤自动识别战损档，狐猎界面不再需要点多次；骨妹未选奥契丝时不再显示奥契丝文字，战斗中热切后奥斯提归位；修复愚者与希尔德的头像、对话串号，AncientWaifus 遗物图鉴跟随当前选择。
缓存与诊断：缓存总预算 16 GB 并按实际字节检查空间；内置崩溃诊断限额，外部 StS2CrashWatch 小转储保留 2 份。
Crash and stability: large visual packs such as CZN mount with much less memory and reuse the mounted pack; claiming card rewards no longer crashes; Spine packs that only ship imported textures fall back to the vanilla model when a page is missing; the stable-version multiplayer lobby patch no longer binds a renamed parameter; a switching failure during multiplayer combat now degrades to the vanilla model instead of faulting; card portraits use an LRU cache with negative caching only for real failures.
Compatibility and UI: merchants stay clickable after repeated hot switches; Character Select in Fear/Fast mode detects the damage variant of the selected skin, and the Kaguya screen no longer needs multiple clicks; Orchis text appears only when Orchis is selected, and Osty keeps its slot after a hot switch; Fool and Hilde portrait/dialogue cross-talk fixed, AncientWaifus relic art follows the current choice.
Cache and diagnostics: 16 GB total cache budget with per-write byte checks; bounded built-in crash dumps and StS2CrashWatch retention.
